_comment: Sources for the solver compatibility matrix, see tools/compat_matrix.py.
'kind' is either 'conda' (conda-forge linux-64 packages) or 'pypi'
(manylinux x86-64 wheels). Both enumerate every published version over a
JSON API and need no account. GitHub releases are deliberately not used:
HiGHS, for one, only started attaching binaries at v1.13.0, which would
silently drop the older versions the table is most interesting for.
'package' is not always the package a user would pip install: FICO splits
the Xpress binding from the solver, so 'xpress' is a 1.6MB pure binding
that declares a dependency on 'xpresslibs', and only the latter carries
libxprs.so. COPT has no usable source: the coptpy wheel exports a C++ API
only, with no COPT_* symbol in any of its shared objects from 7.0 to 8.0,
and the C library is published neither on PyPI nor on conda-forge, so its
rows can only ever read 'no library in archive'.
'lib_patterns' are globs, relative to the extracted archive, tried in
order; the candidate exporting the most wrapper symbols wins. Wheels keep
their real library in an auditwheel '.libs' directory -- the top-level
'*.cpython-*.so' is an extension module that cannot be dlopen'd on its own.
'version_regex' pulls the *solver* version out of the library filename,
since a wheel's version is the binding's, not the solver's (PySCIPOpt
5.2.1 ships libscip 9.1). When it does not match, the package version is
reported instead and marked with '~'.

gurobi.note: the wheel bundles a size-limited licence, so results only cover small models

mosek.note: needs a licence file; without one every test skips on license_error. validated_versions rests on the release the wrapper was written against and a maintainer's local full run of MOSEK 11.0.14 (2026-09-19)

xpress.note: community licence caps model size. validated_versions rests on the release the wrapper was written against and a maintainer's local full run of Xpress 47.1.1 (2026-09-19)

copt.note: community licence caps model size. validated_versions rests on the release the wrapper was written against and a maintainer's local full run of COPT 8.0.5 (2026-09-19)
